summary: the USB suite's two wake-to-dispatch rows of usb_latency.sh, on harness kernels with faults in the preemption and the service point

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make harness-kernel test-image build/tests/system/harness && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2-harness/kernel images/test.krffs

faults.name: preempt
faults.summary: the preemption after a device interrupt taken out, so a reader the keyboard woke waits for the timer, whose tick pumps the controller first, and the spin row fails its count of pumps

edits.find: sched_preempt(); /* a woken reader runs now, or at the call's exit */

faults.name: service
faults.summary: the service point in a large random read taken out, so the reader waits for the whole eight-mebibyte call and the random row fails its count of bytes
